newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA TO FACE S.AFRICA HOPEFULS UNDER LIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA TO FACE S.AFRICA HOPEFULS UNDER LIGHTS.

text.p: South Africa have included established players and some of the brightest prospects in their A team to play India in a one-day match at the end of the month.
John Commins, who captains the side, and Herschelle Gibbs have test experience, while Gerhardus Liebenberg, Derek Crookes and Nicky Boje have played in one-day internationals.
The selectors are looking to the future in calling up a pair of 20-year-olds, Free State batsman Boeta Dippenaar and Border wicketkeeper Mark Boucher.
Border seamer Makhaya Ntini's call-up represents the strides being made by the United Cricket Board's development programme.

The 12 for the day-night match in Pietermaritzburg on January 30 is John Commins (captain), Gerhardus Liebenberg, Piet Botha, Louis Koen, Herscelle Gibbs, Derek Crookes, Boeta Dippenaar, Mark Boucher, Nicky Boje, Rudi Bryson, Makhaya Ntini, Wayne Kidwell.
